_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in solana.wsUrl / solana.httpUrl with a Helius key (free tier is enough), plus your Telegram bot token and chat id. Robinhood Chain needs no key.

roster.notes: EVM side is an EIP-7702 delegated ERC-4337 account (delegate 0xe6cae83bde06e4c305530e199d7217f42808555b); nonce 1, zero balance, so trades arrive via a bundler and match on calldata, never on sender. Volume is on Solana.
